title: Archive and Signal Again
author: Elodie Dravenmoor
blurb: Elodie Hartwell, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
